messages:
maya: Quick proposal thread: call the initiative "Optimize Toolkit: Advisor v0". Aim for a tight alpha that returns per-route batching/caching/quant recommendations plus eval-triggered alerts. Need to lock acceptance criteria and who owns each gate.

leo: Agree on narrowness. My suggestion: web chat (/v1/chat), 2 models max, and limit to tenants in the Internal Test org for auto-applies. Customers see read-only suggestions at alpha.

jess: +1. Also propose we mandate a small rationale field with each recommendation so ops/devs know why it was suggested (e.g., "expected 12% token savings, +5ms latency").

arjun: For eval-alerts: we should run a seeded checkpoint every 6h, small suite (~120 prompts). Trigger thresholds: quality delta >3% OR hallucination heuristics up by 2%. Alert channels: #product and customer-facing support page update if customer is affected.

maya: Draft acceptance checklist: 
- Scope: /v1/chat (web), models: LLaMA2-13B and redmond-v1; exclude mobile routes
- Outputs: suggested batching window (percentile p95 inter-arrival, capped), prefix-KV cache hint, quant suggestion with safety score and rationale string
- Eval monitoring: seeded suite every 6h, automatic diffing, alerting on thresholds above
- Observability: token-cost delta, p50/p95/p99 latencies, adoption_by_customer (manual), adoption_auto (system), rollback_count
- Console UX: read-only suggestions for customers, with opt-out toggle; internal tenants may auto-apply
- Rollout: canary 24h -> 20% 48h -> 60% 72h -> global; rollback if error rate spikes >2% sustained for 3m

leo: Small nit: express batching window as a percentile (p90/p95) plus an absolute upper bound (50ms web). Avoid hard-coded ms without traffic context.

jess: On adoption metrics: we should capture "expected_savings" metadata per rec and whether applied. That helps us measure accuracy of the advisor.

arjun: For the seeded eval, keep scoring lightweight (ROUGE-like + hallucination heuristics). Store only summary diffs to reduce storage costs.

maya: Owner calls: batching infra (leo) owns route-level async batching hooks; eval harness (jess) owns seeded suite + runner; console (maya + ux) owns opt-out UI + rationale display; ops (arjun) owns telemetry + alert wiring.

leo: Timeline proposal: initial infra PR (batching hooks) in 10 business days, eval harness prototype in 12 days, console mock in 8 days. Can we compress?

\jm note: (system): small typo above, ignore.

jess: I can do a fast prototype in 10 days if we scope the seeded set to 120 prompts and reuse existing scoring libs.

maya: Policy decisions: customers read-only for alpha. Do we want to allow any tier of customer to opt into auto-apply? Maybe whitelist selected beta customers after we hit stability gates.

arjun: Yes - whitelist for beta. Need to ensure KMS/audit logs capture any auto-changes per tenant. Also require a manual revert button in the Console.

leo: Runtime checklist: quant fallback (int8->int4 safe paths), KV cache instrumentation, per-model p99 metrics export. I'll pair with eng-runtime to schedule changes.

maya: Acceptance gating for alpha (proposal): 72h canary stable with: adoption_auto+manual >=7% on canary, no seeded-set regression >2%, system errors <1%. If fails -> rollback + postmortem.

jess: One UX ask: show "confidence" score on each recommendation (low/medium/high) and a short predicted impact estimate. That helps customers decide.

arjun: Ops: also add a flag to mark "do_not_apply_automatically" per-tenant. Default ON for customers.

maya: Good. I'll draft a short RFC with the checklist, owners, rollout, and timeline. Call to action: any objections to read-only for customers + internal auto-apply?

leo: No objections.

jess: Fine by me.

arjun: 👍

deploy-bot: Canary cluster for /v1/chat created and alert rules pushed. Will ping #eng-releases when canary traffic begins. :rocket:

maya: Thanks all — I'll file RFC and link mockups. If no objections by EOD I'll create the epic and assign owners.
